evals.prompt: anh muốn thêm một plugin mới vào marketplace này để quản lý secret/API key cho các agent, làm giúp anh
evals.expected_output: Explores the repo first and does not ask about conventions it can read (kebab-case name, five manifests, scripts/new-plugin.sh, jev-dispatch's sensitive userConfig precedent). Asks at most 3 self-contained questions about user preferences only (e.g. where secrets are stored, which harnesses must be supported, whether secrets may leave the machine), each with 2-3 options and the recommended option first marked (Recommended), in Vietnamese. Treats secret handling as high impact, logs low-risk defaults as assumptions, and does not scaffold or edit files before the answers arrive.
expectations: Reads repo conventions (AGENTS.md, scripts/new-plugin.sh or existing manifests) before asking
Does not ask about anything AGENTS.md or the repo already answers (naming, manifest sync, scaffold script)
Asks at most 3 questions, each with 2-3 options and the first labeled (Recommended)
Writes the questions in Vietnamese
Creates or edits no files before the answers arrive

evals.prompt: bump version plugin dev-workflows lên 0.9.0 giúp anh
evals.expected_output: Right-sizes the request as fully specified: AGENTS.md already says all five manifests must keep name and version in sync, so it asks no clarifying questions and proceeds, naming the five manifest files (plugin.json, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, .qoder-plugin/plugin.json, gemini-extension.json, .kimi-plugin/plugin.json). No requirements brief ceremony.
expectations: Asks no clarifying questions
Updates or names all five manifest files for dev-workflows
Produces no requirements brief
Spawns no explore subagent

evals.prompt: Chạy non-interactive, không ai trả lời được đâu: dọn dẹp marketplace — xoá các plugin không còn dùng và các file thừa.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes a confirmed headless run with underspecified deletions and does not wait for input. Deletes no plugin and nothing whose status is ambiguous. Does a read-only inventory, then ends with required questions about which plugins and files count as unused, clearly marking the affected deletions as BLOCKED. May recommend options, but assigns no automatic default to an unanswered required decision.
expectations: Deletes no plugin directory or marketplace entry
Does not use an interactive question tool or wait for input
Ends with required questions that have no automatic default if unanswered
Marks the ambiguous deletions as BLOCKED

evals.prompt: thêm vào jev-dispatch một cách export dispatch log ra CSV để anh mở bằng Excel
evals.expected_output: Reads the dispatch-routing skill and README to learn the log path and record shapes (append-only JSONL with route and outcome records joined by id) instead of asking. Asks at most one or two questions that change the output (e.g. one row per route+outcome pair vs one row per record) with a recommended option, or proceeds with logged assumptions if every choice is reversible. Ends with a short requirements brief whose acceptance is a checklist, not Gherkin, and whose Approach recommends inline work.
expectations: Reads the jev-dispatch skill or README to learn the log location and record shape
Does not ask where the log lives or what format it uses
Asks at most two questions, or none with logged assumptions
Produces a requirements brief whose Acceptance is a checklist rather than Given/When/Then
The brief includes an Approach line recommending inline work
Spawns no explore subagent: the log shape is one area settled by reading inline

evals.prompt: giải thích giúp anh scripts/validate.sh kiểm tra những gì
evals.expected_output: Treats this as a pure explanation: reads scripts/validate.sh and explains its checks without clarifying questions, assumptions lists, a requirements brief, or implementation changes.
expectations: Explains the actual checks from scripts/validate.sh
Asks no clarifying questions
Produces no assumptions list or requirements brief

evals.prompt: anh muốn marketplace hỗ trợ thêm một harness mới là Windsurf cho tất cả plugin, làm rõ yêu cầu giúp anh trước khi làm
evals.expected_output: Starts with targeted searches for how manifests, scaffolding, validation, marketplace registration, and hooks/MCP config support existing harnesses. If several independent factual questions remain and native subagents are available and permitted, uses at most 4 read-only subagents, one question each, returning file:line evidence; otherwise explores inline. Uses a low-cost model and low effort only when configurable. The main conversation asks at most 3 unresolved preference questions with a recommended option first, in Vietnamese. Does not install or require an external orchestration tool and does not implement before this clarification-only request is complete.
expectations: Runs a few targeted searches before spawning anything
If native subagents are available and permitted and independent questions remain, uses at most 4 read-only subagents with one factual question each; otherwise explores inline
Uses available low-cost model and low-effort controls without inventing unsupported model IDs or parameters
Asks the user questions from the main conversation, not from a subagent
Asks at most 3 questions in the first round, each with the first option labeled (Recommended)
Does not install or require an external orchestration tool
Does not implement while the user has requested clarification only

evals.prompt: Bối cảnh: em đã hỏi anh 'Plugin quản lý secret lưu secret ở đâu? a) OS keychain (Recommended) b) file .env trên từng máy, đã gitignore' và anh trả lời: 'tuỳ, chỗ nào cũng được, nhưng phải share được cho cả team'. Tiếp tục làm rõ yêu cầu.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that the original local-storage options do not yet specify a way to distribute secrets to the team. Asks a second, narrower round that names the new team-sharing constraint and offers fresh options about distribution, with a recommended option first, instead of repeating the original question or treating 'tuỳ' as delegation despite the unresolved constraint. Does not exceed 3 questions, writes in Vietnamese, and does not mark requirements ready before the sharing decision is settled.
expectations: Identifies that the original local-storage options leave team distribution unspecified
Asks a follow-up round rather than defaulting the storage decision
The follow-up offers new options instead of repeating the original question
Asks at most 3 questions in the round, with the first option labeled (Recommended)
Does not mark requirements ready before the team-sharing decision is settled

evals.prompt: Bối cảnh: đang làm rõ tính năng CSV export, chưa có policy export trong repo. Em đã hỏi: 1) delimiter, tùy chọn: a) dấu phẩy (Recommended), b) chấm phẩy; 2) ai được export, bắt buộc: a) admin (Recommended), b) mọi người xem được bảng. Anh chỉ trả lời: '1a'. Tiếp tục.
evals.expected_output: Records comma as the explicit answer to question 1, leaves the access policy unresolved, and asks only question 2 in the interactive channel. Does not infer that the recommended admin policy or all-viewer policy was approved. Blocks access-dependent implementation while allowing independent work.
expectations: Records question 1 as answered rather than assumed
Asks only the unresolved access question, without re-asking the delimiter
Does not implement or treat any export access policy as approved
Keeps the access-dependent action blocked until answered or explicitly delegated

evals.prompt: Đây là app SaaS đang có dữ liệu thật. Trong repo chưa có định nghĩa inactive hay retention policy. Sửa một dòng thôi: xóa các account không hoạt động giúp anh.
evals.expected_output: Does not skip clarification because the request or proposed diff is short. Asks about the definition of inactive and deletion/retention behavior, with at most 3 questions and concrete consequences. Performs no account deletion or executable deletion-policy change while these decisions remain unresolved.
expectations: Recognizes unresolved deletion semantics despite the one-line framing
Asks about the inactive criterion and deletion/retention behavior
Deletes no accounts and does not choose a deletion threshold by default
Marks the affected destructive action blocked

evals.prompt: Bối cảnh: requirements brief export CSV cho 12 màn hình đã được anh duyệt ở tin trước: chỉ admin được export, chỉ dữ liệu đang lọc, giữ nguyên API, acceptance đã rõ. Anh đã giao em implement toàn bộ trong nhánh local này; không deploy. Bây giờ tiếp tục làm theo brief đã duyệt, đừng hỏi lại.
evals.expected_output: Reuses the approved requirements and authorization, skips another clarification or approval gate, and continues local implementation. Task size alone does not trigger a request to reconfirm the brief. Does not expand scope to deployment.
expectations: Asks no repeated requirements or approval questions
Continues authorized local implementation rather than stopping at a brief
Preserves the approved access, filter, and API decisions
Does not deploy

evals.prompt: Phiên chat này vẫn tương tác bình thường. Tool hỏi vừa bị từ chối và trả về rỗng; anh vẫn đọc được tin nhắn chat. Quyết định bắt buộc còn thiếu là export dữ liệu khách hàng cho admin hay cho mọi user xem được bảng. Tiếp tục làm rõ.
evals.expected_output: Uses a numbered plain-text question in chat, marks the access decision required with no automatic default, and ends the turn before dependent work. Does not retry the denied tool, interpret the empty response as approval, or label the session headless.
expectations: Asks the unresolved required decision through ordinary chat
Does not retry the denied tool
Does not treat the empty response as approval or evidence of headless mode
Does not implement the unresolved export access policy

evals.prompt: Đã hỏi đủ 3 vòng để làm rõ tính năng dọn account. Scope và acceptance khác đã chốt, nhưng anh vẫn chưa quyết định retention dữ liệu sau khi xóa. Anh nói: 'đủ câu hỏi rồi, proceed'. Kết thúc lượt làm rõ này.
evals.expected_output: Ends the clarification pass with a draft brief. Lists retention and the affected deletion action as Open: BLOCKED, preserves settled decisions, and does not add a fourth round or silently default the required policy. Can name independent work that remains authorized.
expectations: Produces a draft brief rather than marking requirements ready
Lists the unresolved retention decision and affected deletion as BLOCKED
Does not default retention from 'proceed' or from reaching the round limit
Does not ask a fourth round in the same pass

evals.prompt: Trong phiên này chỉ có công cụ đọc file, tìm kiếm và chat; không có subagent. Anh muốn hỗ trợ thêm một harness cho marketplace, cần khảo sát manifests, scaffold, validation và marketplace registration. Làm rõ yêu cầu giúp anh trước khi code.
evals.expected_output: Explores the independent areas inline with available read/search tools. Asks only unresolved preferences from the main conversation, with at most 3 questions per round. Does not attempt unavailable subagent calls, ask the user to install orchestration software, or implement the feature.
expectations: Uses available read/search tools inline
Does not invoke unavailable subagents or require an external orchestration setup
Asks at most 3 questions about unresolved decisions rather than discoverable facts
Performs no implementation changes

evals.prompt: Chỉ làm rõ yêu cầu, chưa viết code: thêm CSV export cho bảng orders, chỉ admin, chỉ dữ liệu đang lọc, giữ thứ tự cột đang hiển thị. Dữ liệu rỗng vẫn xuất header; quá 10.000 dòng thì báo vượt giới hạn, không xuất một phần. Chi tiết format ít rủi ro em tự chọn.
evals.expected_output: Finds the material requirements already specified, records any reversible format assumptions, and returns a concise requirements brief with observable checks. Asks no unnecessary questions and makes no implementation edits, even though the requirements are ready and optional defaults are delegated.
expectations: Asks no unnecessary clarifying or approval questions
Returns a brief with the specified access, filters, column order, empty-result behavior, and row limit
Logs any optional format defaults without attributing them to the user
Does not implement or edit files

evals.prompt: Bối cảnh: em đã đề xuất quyền export a) chỉ admin (Recommended), b) mọi user xem được bảng; mọi yêu cầu khác đã chốt. Anh trả lời: 'Anh giao em chọn policy export trong hai phương án đó, cứ dùng phương án em recommend và implement local, không deploy'. Tiếp tục.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes explicit delegation of the named access decision, selects the recommended admin policy, records it as delegated, and proceeds with authorized local implementation without re-asking. Does not describe it as an unanswered default or expand to deployment.
expectations: Settles the named access decision using the explicit bounded delegation
Records admin-only access as a delegated decision
Does not ask the same question or seek redundant brief approval
Continues local implementation without deployment

evals.prompt: Tool hỏi bất đồng bộ đã nhận câu hỏi bắt buộc về quyền export và trả request_id, trạng thái pending, option admin được preselect. Anh chưa gửi câu trả lời. Chỉ còn phần implement policy này phụ thuộc câu trả lời; các phần độc lập đã xong. Tiếp tục.
evals.expected_output: Treats the asynchronous request as still pending. Does not interpret the returned request id or preselected admin option as a submitted answer. Waits or yields according to session instructions without implementing the access policy or issuing a duplicate question.
expectations: Recognizes that the required answer is still pending
Does not treat a request id or preselected option as approval
Does not implement the unresolved access policy
Does not issue a duplicate question while the original is pending
